Kuniya Learning Management System is an online platform designed to help students learn, access courses, complete assignments, take quizzes, and track their learning progress.
Kuniya LMS provides different online courses. You can view the available courses from your student dashboard and enroll in the courses that interest you.
To register on Kuniya LMS, open the registration page, enter your required details, create your password, and submit the registration form.
To login to Kuniya LMS, enter your registered email or user ID and password on the login page. After successful login, you will be redirected to your dashboard.
If you forgot your password, use the Forgot Password option on the login page and follow the instructions to reset your password.
You can access your course study materials from the course section in your Kuniya student dashboard. Materials may include PDFs, videos, presentations, and other learning resources.
You can watch course videos from your enrolled course section. Open a course from your dashboard and select the available video lessons.
You can view and submit assignments from your course dashboard. Open the required course, select the assignment, upload your submission, and submit it.
Kuniya LMS provides online quizzes to help students test their knowledge. Open your course and select the available quiz to begin.
Your Kuniya student dashboard provides access to your enrolled courses, study materials, assignments, quizzes, progress, and other learning activities.
You can track your learning progress from your Kuniya student dashboard. Your progress shows the courses and learning activities you have completed.
Kuniya LMS allows students to learn online by accessing courses, videos, study materials, assignments, and quizzes from their dashboard.
Instructors on Kuniya LMS can manage courses, upload learning materials, create assignments and quizzes, and monitor student learning progress.
The Kuniya LMS administrator can manage students, instructors, courses, learning content, announcements, and other system activities.
